desc: The Shuffle DIY, in its garage-appropriate black-and-gray coloring, features a bit driver and two screwdriver bits, bottlecap opener plus a keychain ring along with the handy features other Shuffles are known for. This compact knife is equipped with a shorter, but wider, blade of quality stainless steel. Sturdy glass-filled nylon handles with texture and finger contours for solid grip. Manual opening; can be opened one-handed with thumb stud.
